questions.q: An admin creates a custom object labeled Project. What is its API name in SOQL?
options: Project__c
Project
Custom_Project
__c_Project
questions.explain: Custom objects get an API name ending in the __c suffix, so the Project object is queried as Project__c.

questions.q: A custom field is labeled Start Date. Which API name would you use in a query?
options: Start_Date__c
Start Date
StartDate
Start_Date__r
questions.explain: Spaces in the label become underscores and the __c suffix is appended, producing Start_Date__c.

questions.q: In SELECT Id, Name, Region__c FROM Account, which items carry a custom suffix and why?
options: Only Region__c, because Account, Id, and Name are standard while Region__c is a custom field
All three fields, because they are all in one query
Only Account, because it is the object
None of them, because suffixes are not used in SELECT lists
questions.explain: The suffix marks whatever is custom. Custom fields can be added to standard objects, and Id and Name are standard fields.

questions.q: What is the difference between Account__c and Account__r.Name on a custom object with a lookup to Account?
options: Account__c holds the related record's Id, while Account__r.Name follows the relationship to return the account's name
They are two spellings of the same field
Account__r.Name only works in ORDER BY
Account__c returns the name and Account__r returns the Id
questions.explain: __c is the lookup field holding the Id. __r is the relationship name used in dot notation to reach fields on the related record.

questions.q: A query returns 'No such column Budget on entity Project__c' and suggests appending __c. If adding __c does not help, what should you check next?
options: The exact API name in Object Manager and whether the user has field-level security access to the field
Whether SELECT * would work instead
Whether the query needs a JOIN
Whether the object name should end in __r
questions.explain: Confirm the spelling in Object Manager, and remember that missing field-level security can produce the same error.
